project.name: DCSS Meeting Scheduler
project.author: Department of Computer Studies and Systems (DCSS)

files_to_upload.description: Main entry point and role-based redirect router
Authentication screen with UE credentials validation
Account registration for Students and Faculty
Destroys session and returns to login page
Faculty Portal with KPIs, requests, consultation hours, and settings
Student Portal with booking, request tracking, and profile
Admin Dashboard with user management and overall metrics
Session auth guard and role permission checker
Responsive styling maintaining the original UI design
Apache protection rules for config and includes folders

deployment_steps: 1. Log in to Hostinger hPanel and navigate to 'Databases' -> 'MySQL Databases'.
2. Create a new database and user. Note down the Database Name, User, and Password.
3. Open phpMyAdmin for your new database and import 'db/migrations/schema.sql'.
4. In hPanel, go to 'File Manager' -> open 'public_html'.
5. Upload all files and folders from the local 'web/' directory into 'public_html'.
6. Open 'public_html/config/database.php' in File Manager and enter your Hostinger DB credentials.
7. Ensure PHP version is set to 8.1 or 8.2 under 'Advanced' -> 'PHP Configuration' in hPanel.
8. Open your domain in any browser to verify your live site.
